value.name: urge facing difficult truths together
value.description: The speaker urges the family to confront painful truths together out of loyalty to their mother.
evidence: t difficult truths; we owe it to our mother to face this together, for her love is the thread that will guide us through the darkness.

value.name: Lucia expresses uncertainty and fear of losing mother
value.description: Lucia admits she feels uncertain and worries that delay will cause their mother's spirit to be lost in the house.
evidence: Lucia: "I just wish I could feel more certain, Rosa; every moment we hesitate feels like a step closer to losing her spirit in this house forever."

value.name: Rosa suggests searching sewing supplies
value.description: Rosa recalls their mother's habit of hiding important papers and proposes searching the sewing supplies baskets for clues.
evidence: Rosa: "Lucia, I remember how your mother would tuck away her most precious papers in the most unexpected places; perhaps we should start by looking where she kept her sewing supplies—those baskets might hold more than just fabric."

value.name: Lucia agrees to search hidden baskets
value.description: Lucia accepts Rosa's idea and commits to digging deeper for their mother's intentions.
evidence: Lucia: "You're right; those baskets could be hiding more than we realize, and if there's a chance to uncover our mother's intentions, we owe it to her to dig deeper."

value.name: Rosa urges uncovering hidden wishes
value.description: Rosa encourages Lucia to look beyond the fabric and uncover the hidden corners that may reveal their mother's true wishes.
evidence: Rosa: "Let’s not just sift through the fabric, Lucia; let’s uncover the heart of what she treasured—those hidden corners may hold the keys to her true wishes."

value.name: Lucia begins search with mother's guidance
value.description: Lucia resolves to begin the search, feeling her mother's presence guiding them toward what she left behind.
evidence: Lucia: "Then let's begin, Rosa; I can already feel her presence guiding us, urging us to uncover the love and truth she left behind."

value.name: Rosa frames house as story of legacy
value.description: Rosa says every stitch in the house tells a story and that they will weave those stories into understanding that honors their mother's legacy.
evidence: Rosa: "Remember, Lucia, every stitch in this house tells a story; together we’ll weave those stories into a tapestry of understanding that honors her legacy."

value.name: Lucia hears mother's voice in fabric
value.description: Lucia imagines hearing her mother's voice in the fabric and commits to uncovering the stories and honoring her love.
evidence: Lucia: "I can almost hear her voice in the rustle of the fabric, urging us to find what she left behind; let’s uncover those stories and honor her love with every thread we pull."

value.name: Rosa anchors them in shared love and memory
value.description: Rosa emphasizes that their shared love will help them navigate the memories and secrets left by their mother.
evidence: Rosa: "Yes, Lucia, and as we uncover those stories, let’s hold onto the love that binds us; it will be our anchor as we navigate through the memories and secrets she left for us."
